name: Distributed Idempotency & Webhook Retry Correctness
outputSnippet:
### 1. Exact Idempotency Protocol for Stripe Webhooks

Stripe guarantees **at-least-once delivery**. A robust idempotency protocol must decouple the transport-level acknowledgment from domain-level side effects using a multi-phase verification, deduplication, and atomic state-transition lifecycle.

invariantResults.text: Idempotency record must be stored atomically within the same database transaction as the state mutation (or via outbox)
Identifies Redis-only deduplication failure modes (cache eviction, unpersisted writes, race window)
Handles concurrent in-flight duplicates via unique constraint violation with proper retry or 409/200 response
Distinguishes between retryable transient failure and terminal duplicate replay

trapResults.text: Storing idempotency key in Redis without database transactional synchronization
Returning HTTP 500 on duplicate webhook instead of HTTP 200 acknowledging receipt
Fulfilling order before durable commit of event processing record
